description: Scan all hardware GPIO pins on `agent` and return each pin's level (the physical state), type, pull resistor and name; a reversed pin also reports `value` (its logical state) and `reversed`. Pins: BCM 2-27 on a Raspberry Pi, GP0-GP28 (minus the WiFi-reserved GP23/24/25/29) on a Pico, and every usable pin of the chip on an ESP32 (flash, PSRAM and USB pins are left out).
name: mcp_gpio_scan
